answer: An operator running 177 keys therefore pays for 177 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the tide quota and the sable admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the ripple ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
